map.为什么不同年份同一作物收益差别很大？: Why Does the Profit of the Same Crop Vary So Much Between Years?
map.产量受气候与病虫害影响，价格随市场供需波动，成本中人工与农资逐年上涨。建议用近: Yield is affected by climate and pests, prices fluctuate with market supply and demand, and labour and agricultural input costs rise every year. Use the mean of the last 3 years for a trend judgement rather than a single year.
map.估算单季种植净收益：净收益 = 产量×单价 − (种子+肥料+农药+机械+人工): Estimate the net profit of a single planting season: net profit = yield × unit price − (seed + fertiliser + pesticide + machinery + labour) cost.
map.填写「需配制药液量 (L)」。: Enter the "volume of solution to mix (L)".
map.对比不同作物或品种的盈亏平衡点，辅助种植结构调整。: Compare the break-even points of different crops or varieties to support adjustments in the planting structure.
map.涵盖肥料配比、种植密度、农药稀释、灌溉水量、孵化倒计时、农机油耗等常用农业计算: Covers common agricultural calculations such as fertiliser ratios, planting density, pesticide dilution, irrigation water volume, incubation countdowns and farm machinery fuel use
map.结合补贴政策，核算含直接补贴后的实际到手收益。: Combine the subsidy policy to compute the actual net income after direct subsidies.
map.综合页含 6 组子计算器：① 肥料配比按「总量 = 面积 × 每亩用量」，氮/磷: The composite page contains 6 groups of sub-calculators: (1) fertiliser ratio uses "total = area × dosage per mu", with nitrogen / phosphorus / potassium each taken as a content percentage; (2) planting density uses plant spacing × row spacing to convert to the area per plant; (3) pesticide dilution takes the ratio of the stock concentration to the target concentration to get the dilution factor, then multiplies by the target water volume to get the dose; (4) irrigation water uses area × irrigation depth (mm) to convert to volume and scales it by the application efficiency into gross water use; (5) the incubation countdown advances day by day for 21 days from the setting-in date; (6) farm machinery fuel uses the operating area × fuel use per mu, then converts to cost at the fuel price. Each sub-item is independent and they are all summarised in the same result area.
map.肥料总量 = 面积 × 每亩用量；养分用量 = 总量 × 含量%；密度 = 1: Total fertiliser = area × dosage per mu; nutrient amount = total × content %; density = 1 ÷ (plant spacing × row spacing); dilution factor = stock concentration ÷ target concentration; irrigation water = area × irrigation depth; fuel use = operating area × fuel use per mu
map.补贴属于转移性收入，是否计入看用途。做经营测算时建议单列为『政策收益』，与经营性: A subsidy is transfer income, and whether to count it depends on its purpose. In a business projection it is best to list it separately as "policy income", apart from the operating net income, so that the profitability of the main business is not overstated.
map.补贴要不要计入净收益？: Should the Subsidy Be Counted in the Net Income?
map.：亩产 450 kg、单价 2.6 元/kg，毛收入 1170 元；成本：种子: : with a yield of 450 kg per mu at 2.6 CNY/kg, the gross income is 1170 CNY; costs: seed 60 + base fertiliser 120 + top dressing 80 + pesticide 40 + tillage and harvesting 160 + labour 100 = 560 CNY. Net income = 1170 − 560 = 610 CNY per mu. If there is also a 100 CNY per mu farmland productivity protection subsidy, the actual net amount is about 710 CNY.
